title: Zero-config home-LAN peer key preservation and attested status fallback
goal: Keep zero-config home-LAN cluster members attested across UDP discovery refreshes: a refresh that carries no key keeps the row's bound node_id, pubkey, key_bound_at and bind_sig. `susi peers status` reports a key-bound member that discovery still sees but whose status call fails (for example inbound TCP refused by the member's OS firewall) truthfully: the row carries the error, live_via_discovery and the key prefix, and none of the unmeasured term, leader, ledger size or key epoch, so divergence stays visible. (Taken over by Claude on the CEO's instruction 2026-11-09 02:20 after Antigravity finished; the earlier version copied this node's state into the member's row.) Also fixes the root of a gate failure met while landing: crates/susi-daemon/src/watchdog.rs test_watchdog_timeout raced the wall clock (50 ms timeout, two 30 ms sleeps; under gate load both cells read dead). The watchdog now takes its clock as an input internally; the public methods still use Instant::now(), and the test states exact instants.
